display_name: 源域物理后验修正教师生成
description: 仅对 8192 条合法源 IQ 的三个模拟视图，基于 DURA 估计信道与噪声、源相关先验，以及同记录源 clean IQ 的非负限幅理想步长，生成供后续训练使用的波形教师；教师步长不可部署。
authorization: 用户继续授权研发星地恢复网络；仅源域合法 IQ 诊断，不重启已停止任务。

code.environment: N607 GPU7, CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=7, FP32 TF32 off, batch 32

data.representation: source paired received/clean IQ, source clean second moment, simulated source action/variance
data.contract_ref: docs/PROJECT_PROTOCOL.md: 恢复器主测试口径及源数据权限
data.physical_ids_ref: 8192 fixed eligible L_s/U_s fit IDs x source simulated epochs21/22/23; 672 source pilot IDs excluded

roles.L_s: source IQ pair, no TX identity
roles.U_s: source IQ pair, TX identity hidden

data.validation_ref: Source teacher generation only; not a target test or identification metric

permissions.claim_scope: Source-only nondeployable teacher construction; clean-supervised coefficients not usable on target

checkpoint.initialization: Frozen source-only DURA v1.0, matching source-only 512x512 IQ second moment and deterministic source context cache
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: frozen_dura source provenance; covariance and source context fit IDs exactly match, source summaries show F/TX/V/target reads zero
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: All inputs source-only with matching source physical IDs; source clean is used only to build training teacher
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed source covariance, estimated action/variance, 160 CG and positive step [0,0.5]; no target selection

execution.gpu_policy: Physical GPU7, one this-run worker, at most three total compute workers; preserve others
execution.stop_rule: Stop on source role mismatch, source smoke failure, nonfinite output or any target/F/TX read; preserve stopped group and other owners.

expected_artifacts: teacher.pt: private source-only 24576 IQ targets, retained on N607
result.json: source construction status, accuracy and CG residual

metric_names: source IQ baseline and ideal teacher NMSE

rows.method: Estimated DURA action and noise with frozen source covariance posterior; per-record positive ideal DURA-to-posterior line step uses matched source clean only
rows.purpose: Build immutable source-only training teacher for a separately registered recovery student
rows.seed_notes: Fixed source fit selection 2026110611, original DURA seed 2026092701, fixed source pilot; no target access or parameter optimizer.
rows.budget_ref: 8192 source IQ IDs x 3 views, one estimated-action covariance posterior per view, 160 CG iterations, batch16
expected_artifacts: teacher.pt: private source-only 24576 IQ targets, retained on N607
result.json: source construction status, accuracy and CG residual

notes: Teacher target generation reads only legal paired source IQ, frozen source DURA and source-only covariance; no TX labels, F weights/outputs, V, target IQ or target truth.
The source clean ideal step and its generated target are privileged training-only information; no student may use them at inference.
Per-record posterior uses DURA-estimated action and noise, never simulator true action/noise; posterior CG residuals are recorded.
Immutable teacher cache is a data-preparation run, not a separately evaluated recovery network; any derived student will be independently registered and run all seven Phase1 views.
